fixed.summary: World, screen, floating and debug text are laid out by the same Parley layout as the UI (shaping, kerning, bidi and fallback faces) and drawn from the run-time glyph atlas: a character the font lacks is drawn by the UI's fallback faces instead of nothing, a floating text mixing Latin and Chinese is one line, and measureText returns what drawing takes. An outline's width is a fraction of the run-time field's reach, the same for every font.
